messages:
ina (People Ops): Quick pulse  I'm sketching a "rapid-fire feedback" kit: 30s pasteable lines for ICs, managers, and peers + a tiny calibration row. Goal: usable in async reviews and 1:1s. Can folks sanity-check?

matt (Eng Manager): Love the idea. Can we include a micro-format for research and ops work (non-metric signals)?

ina (People Ops): Draft below — each is one line you can paste into a review in <30s. Please reply with edits.

```
RAPID-FIRE FEEDBACK KIT (paste-ready lines)

IC 30s self-summary (3 short parts, paste as one line):
- Outcome | My role | Quick ask
- e.g. "Outcome: Reduced recs p95 18% (420->344ms) | Role: Led async batching + tests | Ask: 40 node-hours for canary [INF-REQ]"

Non-metric IC example (research/docs):
- e.g. "Outcome: Published 3 model-failure notes adopted by 2 teams | Role: Synthesized experiments & wrote playbook | Ask: 8h PM pairing"

Manager one-liner for skip-levels (paste):
- e.g. "Mgr note: Scoped to MVP; outcome on track; HC ask: [HC-REQ] 1 SWE if runway needed; see tradeoffs."

Peer kudos (30s async):
- Strength: "Shipped canary plan & caught config bug pre-rollout; reduced toil." 
- Growth note: "Would value earlier pairing on rollout planning." 

Manager micro-prompts (drop into 1:1)
- "What's the single smallest ship that proves the idea?"
- "Which committed item would you keep if we could only finish one?"
- "What's the riskiest assumption and how would you test it this sprint?"

Calibration row (one-line, paste after review)
- MET / NEAR (within 10-15%) / SHIFTED (scope trade) / BLOCKED

Ops & HC tagging (so requests surface)
- Append to ask: [HC-REQ] / [INF-REQ] / [DATA-REQ] and optional priority: [P:high|med|low]

Privacy check (one-line to paste if relevant)
- "If this touches customer data, confirm retention & DSR with security before canary."

Quick naming hint (one-line)
- "<team>.<short-goal>.<quarter> e.g. infra.cache-migrate.q3"
```

zoe (SWE): This is great — quick nit: for the IC line, recommend an alternate compact form for folks who prefer bullets: "Outcome // Role // Ask" works well in many tools.

frank (Staff EM): Add a tiny line managers can paste for converting stretch work to learning: "Reclassifying as LEARN: keep 2-sentence hypothesis + experiment + owner+week." Helps avoid drop-through.

ina (People Ops): Good catches. I'll add the "Outcome // Role // Ask" variant and the LEARN reclass line. Any other tags we should standardize?

matt (Eng Manager): Can we standardize priority formatting on asks so recruiter/ops can filter? e.g. use [P:high] not "(high)". Also recommend we publish a tiny FAQ showing how ATS picks up [HC-REQ].

recruit-bot: Noted. We can auto-scan for [HC-REQ] and [P:high] to create a shortlist. Recommend keeping tag names exact.

ina (People Ops): Perfect  I'll finalize and push to templates, add the FAQ blurb, and pin in #people-ops. ETA: today. Thanks for the quick reviews everyone! :sparkles:
